title: No Sound?
hook_vo: No sound? Find it in under a minute.

beats.vo: The tall meter shows what LayerCue sends out.
MUTE silences it, but the meter keeps moving.
Work down the list: MUTE, master, meter.
Here, the slide's own volume was at zero.
